headline: BI Rate Rises to 6%, Here's What Bankers Say
summary: Bank Indonesia raised its benchmark interest rate to 6%. Bankers said the move is important for economic stability and banking liquidity.
why: Bank Indonesia is the central bank that sets the policy rate for Indonesia, which influences rupiah yields, bank lending and capital flows.
why_moved: A policy rate increase raises borrowing costs across the economy and typically pushes up local bond yields, while attracting interest in the rupiah.
original_headline: BI Rate Naik Jadi 6%, Ini Kata Para Bankir
